title: Class 7 'jellyfish' outruns the Little Bird helicopter

tellings.quote: Uh, we have a video of how we fly on "jellyfish" 7th grade, and she changes course, goes windward,

plain: In 2025, an object the team calls a "jellyfish", which they rank at grade 7 on their own scale, changed course and moved into the wind, getting away from their Little Bird, a small helicopter, that was flying toward it. This is told by Skywatcher, a startup that says it can summon UFOs, which says it has video of the chase. If true, something in the sky was moving against the wind faster than a helicopter could follow.
